skills.summary: Match a task to an installed or catalogue skill
skills.job: Search installed and catalogue skills for the best fit to the user's task, and tell the user which to enable without enabling it.
triggers: is there a skill for this
which skill should I use
find a skill that can do this
gotchas: Enabling a skill without the user's say
Picking by name alone
Recommending five when one fits

skills.summary: Design and scaffold an MCP server
skills.job: Design an MCP server with tools, input schemas, error handling and tests, then scaffold it in the user's chosen language.
triggers: build an mcp server
create an mcp tool for this api
scaffold a model context protocol server
gotchas: Tools too coarse or too many
Errors returned as crashes
Writing logs to stdout on a stdio server

skills.summary: Split a large task into checkable steps
skills.job: Break a large request into ordered steps, each with a done check and its dependencies, before starting work.
triggers: break this task down
plan the steps for this
this is too big where do I start
gotchas: Steps without a done check
Hidden dependencies
Splitting by file instead of by outcome

skills.summary: Write a note so a fresh session can continue
skills.job: Write a compact handoff of goal, state, decisions, open items and exact next step for another session or agent.
triggers: write a handoff for the next session
summarise where we are so I can continue later
prepare context for another agent
gotchas: Leaving out why a decision was made
Vague next step
Pasting logs instead of conclusions

skills.summary: Summarise what a session did and left open
skills.job: Produce a short account of what changed, what was verified, what failed and what remains, from the conversation and the working tree.
triggers: summarise this session
what did we do today
give me a recap of the work
gotchas: Claiming work that was never verified
Listing every command
Dropping the failures

skills.summary: Review your own work before presenting it
skills.job: Re-read finished work against the request, check for gaps and unsupported claims, and fix them before reporting.
triggers: double check your work
review what you just did
are you sure about that
gotchas: Reviewing from memory instead of re-reading
Praising instead of testing
Stopping at the first problem found

skills.summary: Agree a short plan, then carry it out
skills.job: Write a short plan, get the user's approval on risky or ambiguous parts, then execute step by step and update the plan as it changes.
triggers: make a plan first then do it
plan before you change anything
show me the plan and then proceed
gotchas: Plan that is just a restatement of the request
Executing before approval on risky steps
Not updating the plan when it changes

skills.summary: Pick the right tool for each step
skills.job: Choose between search, read, run, browser and edit tools for a step, preferring the cheapest tool that answers the question.
triggers: which tool should I use for this
how should the agent look this up
what is the best way to find this out
gotchas: Running commands to read files
Opening a browser for a static page
Reading whole files to find one line

skills.summary: Keep working notes in a scratch file
skills.job: Keep a running notes file of findings, hypotheses and next steps during long work, and use it to avoid repeating work.
triggers: keep notes as you go
track findings in a file
do not lose track of what you found
gotchas: Notes in the project tree that get committed
Never reading the notes back
Notes that become a second report

skills.summary: Set checkpoints during long multi-step work
skills.job: Place checkpoints in long work where the state is saved, verified and reported, so a failure never loses much.
triggers: this will take a while checkpoint it
work in stages and check in
save progress as you go
gotchas: Checkpoints with no verification
Too many check-ins that interrupt the user
No way to resume after a stop

skills.summary: Ask few questions that unblock the work
skills.job: Decide which unknowns block progress, ask only those in one batch with proposed defaults, and proceed on the rest.
triggers: ask me what you need to know
what do you need from me
clarify the request before starting
gotchas: Asking what the files already answer
Many questions in separate turns
No default offered

skills.summary: Prove the work meets the request first
skills.job: Define the acceptance checks, run them, and report only what was observed, naming anything unchecked.
triggers: make sure it works before you say done
verify your changes
prove it is finished
gotchas: Reporting that code should work
Running only the happy path
Hiding a skipped check
